prompt: Open sea seen from high above, filling the whole image edge to edge with water. Three separate blank rectangular cards float flat on the water, far apart from each other, never touching, never overlapping, never stacked, with clear open water between every pair. Each card is landscape-oriented, wider than tall, about 16:9, and large: each one about a quarter of the image width. Each card is seen almost straight on from directly above, its four sides nearly parallel to the image sides, with only a very slight tilt, each tilted a little differently. Each card is a flat off-white #fbfcfd mount with a wide empty inner panel of plain uniform light off-white: the panel is completely blank, one flat even tone, nothing drawn inside it, no picture, no pattern, no lines, no shading. The cards lie in the water, not on top of it: a thin dark ink grey waterline runs all around each card and small engraved ripples drawn as fine concentric lines spread from its four edges. The largest card, the one lowest and nearest the centre, has a thick bold rim of saturated violet #7C5CD6 all around its mount; the other two cards have plain off-white mounts with a thin ink grey outline. The three cards sit in the upper two thirds of the image, spread from the centre to the right side. The left third and the whole bottom of the image are calm open water with only gentle wave lines. Richly detailed engraved nautical chart style, like a fine antique sea chart printed in two inks: the sea built from many layers of fine wave lines and hatching, line density increasing towards the deep water to give depth, tonal bands from deep cerulean at the bottom to lighter cerulean at the top, bathymetric contour lines with small depth soundings drawn as tiny dots, subtle foam strokes and a few glints of light on the crests. Every wave is drawn as visible engraved line work, like a steel engraving, never painted, never smooth. The whole water surface is covered in visible parallel line hatching and cross-hatching, individual ink strokes clearly readable everywhere, all tone made only from the spacing and weight of lines, no flat colour fills, no soft gradients, no brush strokes, no airbrush. Crisp sharp lines of several weights, intricate but calm, premium print quality, high detail, elegant. No realistic objects, no photographic rendering, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, full-bleed. Palette strictly limited to medium cerulean ocean blue #0072a8 and its tints and shades, off-white #fbfcfd, ink grey #13212b and saturated violet #7C5CD6 on the rim of the largest card only.
